outing.copy_body: 从低处的锦绣谷走向高塔的方向，在同一座公园换两种看秋天的角度。园子很大，走累就停。 路线：北京园博园 → 锦绣谷 → 永定塔。约4小时，到首站和返程另计。园区较大，按体力取舍；高塔以外观为基础，不承诺登塔或当期花海。
outing.hero_prompt_english: Beijing Garden Expo Park with sunken Jinxiu Valley terraces planted in autumn gold and rust, winding paths and the tall Liao-Jin-style Yongding Pagoda on a distant wooded rise. Dense colored embroidery creates terrain contours, an adult pauses with a thermos on the path, no mass spring flowers. Original peaceful composition; any people are adults in everyday opaque clothing. Rich full-bleed vertical 1024x1536 scene with specific architecture and concrete activity, no text, labels, logo, watermark, fake map, or reproduced artwork.
